method: Equations: per (arm, program, class, modifier bucket) cell, E = a + b D, least squares with b >= 0 (b = 0 and a = mean when D is constant or the slope is negative) on small, mid10 and mid10k4 (D_DRIVERS); mid14 predicted from the calibration fit with D from the latest calibration inventory's multiplicities, before mid14 is used; a program is validated if its total mid14 error is at most 15%; validated programs are refit on all measured shapes and projected to FeMoco with D from Shape and Layout and the mid14 inventory's multiplicities. Memory: per arm and metric, peak = H + c E with H >= 0, c >= 0 on every calibration-shape program, held out on every measured mid14 program (validated if the largest error is at most 20%), refit on all points after validation. delta = max(0.25, e_E, e_m, e_c); range [max(0, H + (1 - delta) c E_F), H + (1 + delta) c E_F]. Time: power law through the two largest measured equation counts per (arm, program), exponent at least 1, for wall and CPU; upper = max(wall, CPU) x max(2, largest measured wall/CPU ratio); indicative only
